title: Ravena — Economia
description: Painel da economia (Zinthos, Petalitas, Runas). Fonte: analytics.db gravado de hora em hora pela ravena-ai. Mapeamento motivo → tipo em src/services/EconomyAnalyticsMapping.js. O analytics.db guarda epoch em ms; o frser-sqlite-datasource lê colunas de tempo (timeColumns) em segundos, por isso o / 1000 nos SELECT.

target.queryText: SELECT ts / 1000 AS time, label AS text, COALESCE(currency, 'todas') AS tags FROM annotations WHERE (currency IS NULL OR currency = '${moeda}') AND ts >= $__from AND ts < $__to
target.rawQueryText: SELECT ts / 1000 AS time, label AS text, COALESCE(currency, 'todas') AS tags FROM annotations WHERE (currency IS NULL OR currency = '${moeda}') AND ts >= $__from AND ts < $__to

panels.title: Confiança: última carga por fonte
panels.description: Até quando cada fonte está carregada (load_runs). A carga roda no minuto 5 de cada hora; atraso acima de 2 h indica carga falhando. Limiares de cor (verde/amarelo/vermelho) são PROVISÓRIOS, ponto de partida para calibrar.

targets.queryText:
WITH cur(currency) AS (VALUES ('zinthos'), ('petalitas'), ('runas'))
SELECT cur.currency AS fonte,
  (SELECT MAX(window_to) FROM load_runs l WHERE l.source = cur.currency AND l.ok = 1) / 1000 AS dados_ate,
  (SELECT MAX(ts) FROM load_runs l WHERE l.source = cur.currency) / 1000 AS ultima_tentativa,
  ROUND((CAST(strftime('%s', 'now') AS INTEGER) * 1000
         - (SELECT MAX(window_to) FROM load_runs l WHERE l.source = cur.currency AND l.ok = 1)) / 3600000.0, 1) AS horas_de_atraso,
  CASE COALESCE((SELECT available FROM ledger_status s WHERE s.currency = cur.currency), -1)
    WHEN 1 THEN 'com extrato' WHEN 0 THEN 'sem extrato' ELSE 'sem dados' END AS extrato,
  (SELECT CASE WHEN ok = 0 THEN error END FROM load_runs l WHERE l.source = cur.currency ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1) AS ultimo_erro
FROM cur

  (SELECT MAX(ts) FROM load_runs l WHERE l.source = cur.currency) / 1000 AS ultima_tentativa,
  ROUND((CAST(strftime('%s', 'now') AS INTEGER) * 1000
         - (SELECT MAX(window_to) FROM load_runs l WHERE l.source = cur.currency AND l.ok = 1)) / 3600000.0, 1) AS horas_de_atraso,
  CASE COALESCE((SELECT available FROM ledger_status s WHERE s.currency = cur.currency), -1)

FROM cur

panels.title: Moeda sem origem na semana
panels.description: Por moeda, nos 7 dias econômicos completos até o fim do intervalo: Δ massa − Σ(entradas − saídas) do extrato. Positivo = moeda que apareceu sem linha no extrato; negativo = sumiu sem linha. Moeda sem extrato (Jardim hoje) aparece como 'sem extrato'. Status: |%| < 0,5 ok, < 2 atenção, senão alerta. Limiares de cor (verde/amarelo/vermelho) são PROVISÓRIOS, ponto de partida para calibrar.

targets.queryText:
WITH cur(currency) AS (VALUES ('zinthos'), ('petalitas'), ('runas')), snap AS (
  SELECT currency, ts, total, (ts - 25200000) / 86400000 AS d,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY currency, (ts - 25200000) / 86400000 ORDER BY ts) AS rn
  FROM balances
),
op AS (SELECT currency, d, ts, total FROM snap WHERE rn = 1),
dl AS (
  SELECT a.currency, a.d, a.ts AS ta, b.ts AS tb, b.total - a.total AS dtotal, b.total AS total_fim
  FROM op a JOIN op b ON b.currency = a.currency AND b.d = a.d + 1
),
x AS (
  SELECT dl.currency, dl.d, dl.total_fim,
         dl.dtotal - COALESCE((SELECT SUM(f.amount_in - f.amount_out) FROM flows_hourly f
                               WHERE f.currency = dl.currency
                                 AND f.hour >= dl.ta - dl.ta % 3600000
                                 AND f.hour <  dl.tb - dl.tb % 3600000), 0) AS so
  FROM dl
  WHERE COALESCE((SELECT available FROM ledger_status s WHERE s.currency = dl.currency), 1) = 1
),
w AS (
  SELECT cur.currency,
    COALESCE((SELECT available FROM ledger_status s WHERE s.currency = cur.currency), 1) AS avail,
    (SELECT SUM(so) FROM x WHERE x.currency = cur.currency
       AND x.d * 86400000 + 25200000 >= $__to - 604800000 AND x.d * 86400000 + 25200000 < $__to) AS so7,
    (SELECT total FROM balances b WHERE b.currency = cur.currency AND b.ts <= $__to ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1) AS massa
  FROM cur
)
SELECT currency AS moeda,
  CASE WHEN avail = 0 THEN NULL ELSE so7 END AS sem_origem_7d,
  CASE WHEN avail = 0 THEN NULL ELSE ROUND(100.0 * so7 / NULLIF(ABS(massa), 0), 2) END AS pct_da_massa,
  CASE WHEN avail = 0 THEN 'sem extrato'
       WHEN so7 IS NULL OR massa IS NULL THEN 'sem dados'
       WHEN ABS(100.0 * so7 / NULLIF(ABS(massa), 0)) < 0.5 THEN 'ok'
       WHEN ABS(100.0 * so7 / NULLIF(ABS(massa), 0)) < 2 THEN 'atenção'
       ELSE 'alerta' END AS status
FROM w

panels.title: Moeda sem origem por dia
panels.description: Por dia econômico (vira às 04:00 BRT): Δ total entre o primeiro retrato do dia e o do dia seguinte − Σ(entradas − saídas) das horas entre eles. Petalitas fica vazia enquanto o Jardim não tiver extrato. Um dia só aparece quando o dia seguinte já tem retrato.

targets.queryText:
WITH snap AS (
  SELECT currency, ts, total, (ts - 25200000) / 86400000 AS d,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY currency, (ts - 25200000) / 86400000 ORDER BY ts) AS rn
  FROM balances
),
op AS (SELECT currency, d, ts, total FROM snap WHERE rn = 1),
dl AS (
  SELECT a.currency, a.d, a.ts AS ta, b.ts AS tb, b.total - a.total AS dtotal, b.total AS total_fim
  FROM op a JOIN op b ON b.currency = a.currency AND b.d = a.d + 1
),
x AS (
  SELECT dl.currency, dl.d, dl.total_fim,
         dl.dtotal - COALESCE((SELECT SUM(f.amount_in - f.amount_out) FROM flows_hourly f
                               WHERE f.currency = dl.currency
                                 AND f.hour >= dl.ta - dl.ta % 3600000
                                 AND f.hour <  dl.tb - dl.tb % 3600000), 0) AS so
  FROM dl
  WHERE COALESCE((SELECT available FROM ledger_status s WHERE s.currency = dl.currency), 1) = 1
)
SELECT (d * 86400000 + 25200000) / 1000 AS time,
  SUM(CASE WHEN currency = 'zinthos' THEN so END) AS zinthos,
  SUM(CASE WHEN currency = 'petalitas' THEN so END) AS petalitas,
  SUM(CASE WHEN currency = 'runas' THEN so END) AS runas
FROM x
WHERE d * 86400000 + 25200000 >= $__from AND d * 86400000 + 25200000 < $__to
GROUP BY d ORDER BY d

panels.title: Motivos sem mapeamento (7 dias)
panels.description: Motivos novos (ou de propósito sem tipo, como HOSTING_FEE_WAIFU) que caíram em 'unknown'. Mapear em src/services/EconomyAnalyticsMapping.js. Limiares de cor (verde/amarelo/vermelho) são PROVISÓRIOS, ponto de partida para calibrar.

targets.queryText:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS motivos FROM (
  SELECT DISTINCT currency, reason FROM flows_hourly
  WHERE kind = 'unknown' AND hour >= $__to - 604800000 AND hour < $__to
)
targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS motivos FROM (
  SELECT DISTINCT currency, reason FROM flows_hourly
  WHERE kind = 'unknown' AND hour >= $__to - 604800000 AND hour < $__to
)

panels.title: As 3 moedas na semana
panels.description: Massa = último retrato até o fim do intervalo; crescimento = contra o retrato de 7 dias antes. Saída por 100 de entrada: quanto sai para cada 100 que entra (todas as linhas do extrato, inclusive transferências). Maior fonte = motivo com mais entradas. Limiares de cor (verde/amarelo/vermelho) são PROVISÓRIOS, ponto de partida para calibrar.

targets.queryText:
WITH cur(currency) AS (VALUES ('zinthos'), ('petalitas'), ('runas')),
b AS (
  SELECT cur.currency,
    (SELECT total FROM balances x WHERE x.currency = cur.currency AND x.ts <= $__to ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1) AS massa,
    (SELECT total FROM balances x WHERE x.currency = cur.currency AND x.ts <= $__to - 604800000 ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1) AS massa_antes,
    (SELECT SUM(amount_in) FROM flows_hourly f WHERE f.currency = cur.currency AND f.hour >= $__to - 604800000 AND f.hour < $__to) AS entradas,
    (SELECT SUM(amount_out) FROM flows_hourly f WHERE f.currency = cur.currency AND f.hour >= $__to - 604800000 AND f.hour < $__to) AS saidas,
    (SELECT reason FROM flows_hourly f WHERE f.currency = cur.currency AND f.hour >= $__to - 604800000 AND f.hour < $__to
       GROUP BY reason ORDER BY SUM(amount_in) DESC LIMIT 1) AS maior_fonte,
    COALESCE((SELECT available FROM ledger_status s WHERE s.currency = cur.currency), 1) AS avail
  FROM cur
)
SELECT currency AS moeda, massa,
  ROUND(100.0 * (massa - massa_antes) / NULLIF(ABS(massa_antes), 0), 2) AS crescimento_7d,
  CASE WHEN avail = 0 THEN NULL ELSE entradas END AS entradas_7d,
  CASE WHEN avail = 0 THEN NULL ELSE saidas END AS saidas_7d,
  CASE WHEN avail = 0 THEN NULL ELSE ROUND(100.0 * saidas / NULLIF(entradas, 0), 1) END AS saida_por_100_entrada,
  CASE WHEN avail = 0 THEN 'sem extrato' ELSE maior_fonte END AS maior_fonte
FROM b
targets.rawQueryText:
WITH cur(currency) AS (VALUES ('zinthos'), ('petalitas'), ('runas')),
b AS (
  SELECT cur.currency,
    (SELECT total FROM balances x WHERE x.currency = cur.currency AND x.ts <= $__to ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1) AS massa,
    (SELECT total FROM balances x WHERE x.currency = cur.currency AND x.ts <= $__to - 604800000 ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1) AS massa_antes,
    (SELECT SUM(amount_in) FROM flows_hourly f WHERE f.currency = cur.currency AND f.hour >= $__to - 604800000 AND f.hour < $__to) AS entradas,
    (SELECT SUM(amount_out) FROM flows_hourly f WHERE f.currency = cur.currency AND f.hour >= $__to - 604800000 AND f.hour < $__to) AS saidas,
    (SELECT reason FROM flows_hourly f WHERE f.currency = cur.currency AND f.hour >= $__to - 604800000 AND f.hour < $__to
       GROUP BY reason ORDER BY SUM(amount_in) DESC LIMIT 1) AS maior_fonte,
    COALESCE((SELECT available FROM ledger_status s WHERE s.currency = cur.currency), 1) AS avail
  FROM cur
)
SELECT currency AS moeda, massa,
  ROUND(100.0 * (massa - massa_antes) / NULLIF(ABS(massa_antes), 0), 2) AS crescimento_7d,
  CASE WHEN avail = 0 THEN NULL ELSE entradas END AS entradas_7d,
  CASE WHEN avail = 0 THEN NULL ELSE saidas END AS saidas_7d,
  CASE WHEN avail = 0 THEN NULL ELSE ROUND(100.0 * saidas / NULLIF(entradas, 0), 1) END AS saida_por_100_entrada,
  CASE WHEN avail = 0 THEN 'sem extrato' ELSE maior_fonte END AS maior_fonte
FROM b

panels.title: Crescimento da massa (7 dias) — ${moeda}
panels.description: Variação da massa total em 7 dias. Verde < 5%, amarelo < 15%, vermelho acima. Limiares de cor (verde/amarelo/vermelho) são PROVISÓRIOS, ponto de partida para calibrar.

targets.queryText:
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * (a.total - b.total) / NULLIF(ABS(b.total), 0), 2) AS crescimento
FROM (SELECT total FROM balances WHERE currency = '${moeda}' AND ts <= $__to ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1) a,
     (SELECT total FROM balances WHERE currency = '${moeda}' AND ts <= $__to - 604800000 ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1) b
targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * (a.total - b.total) / NULLIF(ABS(b.total), 0), 2) AS crescimento
FROM (SELECT total FROM balances WHERE currency = '${moeda}' AND ts <= $__to ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1) a,
     (SELECT total FROM balances WHERE currency = '${moeda}' AND ts <= $__to - 604800000 ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1) b

panels.title: Saída por 100 de entrada (7 dias) — ${moeda}
panels.description: Quanto sai para cada 100 que entra. Abaixo de 50 a moeda acumula rápido. Limiares de cor (verde/amarelo/vermelho) são PROVISÓRIOS, ponto de partida para calibrar.

targets.queryText:
SELECT CASE WHEN COALESCE((SELECT available FROM ledger_status WHERE currency = '${moeda}'), 1) = 0 THEN NULL
  ELSE ROUND(100.0 * SUM(amount_out) / NULLIF(SUM(amount_in), 0), 1) END AS saida_por_100
FROM flows_hourly WHERE currency = '${moeda}' AND hour >= $__to - 604800000 AND hour < $__to
targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT CASE WHEN COALESCE((SELECT available FROM ledger_status WHERE currency = '${moeda}'), 1) = 0 THEN NULL

FROM flows_hourly WHERE currency = '${moeda}' AND hour >= $__to - 604800000 AND hour < $__to

panels.title: Fatia dos 10% mais ricos — ${moeda}
panels.description: Fração da massa nas 10% contas com mais saldo (entre quem tem saldo > 0). Limiares de cor (verde/amarelo/vermelho) são PROVISÓRIOS, ponto de partida para calibrar.

targets.queryText:
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * top10_share, 1) AS top10 FROM balances
WHERE currency = '${moeda}' AND ts <= $__to AND top10_share IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1
targets.rawQueryText:

panels.title: Moeda sem origem (7 dias, % da massa) — ${moeda}
panels.description: Moeda sem linha no extrato na semana, em % da massa. 'sem extrato' = o serviço ainda não tem extrato (Jardim). Limiares de cor (verde/amarelo/vermelho) são PROVISÓRIOS, ponto de partida para calibrar.

targets.queryText:
WITH snap AS (
  SELECT currency, ts, total, (ts - 25200000) / 86400000 AS d,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY currency, (ts - 25200000) / 86400000 ORDER BY ts) AS rn
  FROM balances
),
op AS (SELECT currency, d, ts, total FROM snap WHERE rn = 1),
dl AS (
  SELECT a.currency, a.d, a.ts AS ta, b.ts AS tb, b.total - a.total AS dtotal, b.total AS total_fim
  FROM op a JOIN op b ON b.currency = a.currency AND b.d = a.d + 1
),
x AS (
  SELECT dl.currency, dl.d, dl.total_fim,
         dl.dtotal - COALESCE((SELECT SUM(f.amount_in - f.amount_out) FROM flows_hourly f
                               WHERE f.currency = dl.currency
                                 AND f.hour >= dl.ta - dl.ta % 3600000
                                 AND f.hour <  dl.tb - dl.tb % 3600000), 0) AS so
  FROM dl
  WHERE COALESCE((SELECT available FROM ledger_status s WHERE s.currency = dl.currency), 1) = 1
)
SELECT CASE WHEN COALESCE((SELECT available FROM ledger_status WHERE currency = '${moeda}'), 1) = 0 THEN NULL
  ELSE ROUND(100.0 * (SELECT SUM(so) FROM x WHERE currency = '${moeda}'
                        AND d * 86400000 + 25200000 >= $__to - 604800000 AND d * 86400000 + 25200000 < $__to)
       / NULLIF(ABS((SELECT total FROM balances WHERE currency = '${moeda}' AND ts <= $__to ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1)), 0), 2) END AS sem_origem

panels.title: De onde vem e para onde vai (7 dias) — ${moeda}
panels.description: Fluxo por motivo do extrato na semana. Tipo vem do mapeamento versionado da ravena (EconomyAnalyticsMapping.js); 'unknown' = motivo sem mapeamento.

targets.queryText:
SELECT reason AS motivo, kind AS tipo,
  SUM(amount_in) AS entradas, SUM(amount_out) AS saidas, SUM(amount_in - amount_out) AS liquido,
  SUM(tx_count) AS transacoes, MAX(users) AS max_jogadores_hora
FROM flows_hourly
WHERE currency = '${moeda}' AND hour >= $__to - 604800000 AND hour < $__to
GROUP BY reason, kind
ORDER BY entradas + saidas DESC
targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT reason AS motivo, kind AS tipo,
  SUM(amount_in) AS entradas, SUM(amount_out) AS saidas, SUM(amount_in - amount_out) AS liquido,
  SUM(tx_count) AS transacoes, MAX(users) AS max_jogadores_hora
FROM flows_hourly
WHERE currency = '${moeda}' AND hour >= $__to - 604800000 AND hour < $__to
GROUP BY reason, kind
ORDER BY entradas + saidas DESC

panels.title: Massa total (12 semanas) — ${moeda}
panels.description: Massa total da moeda nas últimas 12 semanas. Anotações = tabela annotations (mudanças de regra, correções de extrato).

targets.queryText:
SELECT ts / 1000 AS time, total AS massa FROM balances
WHERE currency = '${moeda}' AND ts >= $__to - 12 * 604800000 AND ts < $__to
ORDER BY ts
targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT ts / 1000 AS time, total AS massa FROM balances
WHERE currency = '${moeda}' AND ts >= $__to - 12 * 604800000 AND ts < $__to

panels.title: Entradas e saídas por dia — ${moeda}
panels.description: Somas do extrato por dia econômico (04:00 BRT), no intervalo do painel.

targets.queryText:
SELECT (((hour - 25200000) / 86400000) * 86400000 + 25200000) / 1000 AS time,
  SUM(amount_in) AS entradas, SUM(amount_out) AS saidas, SUM(amount_in - amount_out) AS liquido
FROM flows_hourly
WHERE currency = '${moeda}' AND hour >= $__from AND hour < $__to
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
targets.rawQueryText:

FROM flows_hourly
WHERE currency = '${moeda}' AND hour >= $__from AND hour < $__to

panels.title: Entradas por tipo e dia — ${moeda}
panels.description: Entradas de criação/câmbio/transferência e saídas de destruição/câmbio, por dia.

targets.queryText:
SELECT (((hour - 25200000) / 86400000) * 86400000 + 25200000) / 1000 AS time,
  SUM(CASE WHEN kind = 'creation' THEN amount_in END) AS criacao,
  SUM(CASE WHEN kind = 'exchange_in' THEN amount_in END) AS cambio_entrada,
  SUM(CASE WHEN kind = 'transfer' THEN amount_in END) AS transferencia,
  SUM(CASE WHEN kind = 'destruction' THEN amount_out END) AS destruicao,
  SUM(CASE WHEN kind = 'exchange_out' THEN amount_out END) AS cambio_saida,
  SUM(CASE WHEN kind = 'unknown' THEN amount_in + amount_out END) AS sem_mapeamento
FROM flows_hourly
WHERE currency = '${moeda}' AND hour >= $__from AND hour < $__to
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
targets.rawQueryText:

  SUM(CASE WHEN kind = 'exchange_in' THEN amount_in END) AS cambio_entrada,
  SUM(CASE WHEN kind = 'transfer' THEN amount_in END) AS transferencia,
  SUM(CASE WHEN kind = 'destruction' THEN amount_out END) AS destruicao,
  SUM(CASE WHEN kind = 'exchange_out' THEN amount_out END) AS cambio_saida,
  SUM(CASE WHEN kind = 'unknown' THEN amount_in + amount_out END) AS sem_mapeamento
FROM flows_hourly
WHERE currency = '${moeda}' AND hour >= $__from AND hour < $__to
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Quem recebe: entradas de criação nos últimos 7 dias, por faixa de saldo atual — ${moeda}
panels.description: Contas com saldo > 0 divididas em 5 faixas pelo saldo atual; quanto cada faixa recebeu de motivos de criação nos 7 dias antes do último dia carregado. Faixas com menos de 10 contas vêm vazias (proteção de privacidade).

targets.queryText:
SELECT 'Q' || q || CASE q WHEN 1 THEN ' (menores saldos)' WHEN 5 THEN ' (maiores saldos)' ELSE '' END AS faixa,
  n AS contas, received_sum AS recebido, received_median AS mediana_por_conta,
  ROUND(100.0 * received_sum / NULLIF(SUM(received_sum) OVER (), 0), 1) AS pct_do_recebido
FROM received_by_quintile
WHERE currency = '${moeda}'
  AND day = (SELECT MAX(day) FROM received_by_quintile WHERE currency = '${moeda}' AND day <= $__to)
ORDER BY q

panels.title: Fatia recebida pela faixa de maior saldo (Q5) — ${moeda}
panels.description: Quanto das entradas de criação (janela de 7 dias) foi para a faixa de maior (Q5) e de menor (Q1) saldo, dia a dia.

targets.queryText:
SELECT day / 1000 AS time,
  ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN q = 5 THEN received_sum END) / NULLIF(SUM(received_sum), 0), 1) AS q5,
  ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN q = 1 THEN received_sum END) / NULLIF(SUM(received_sum), 0), 1) AS q1
FROM received_by_quintile
WHERE currency = '${moeda}' AND day >= $__to - 12 * 604800000 AND day < $__to
GROUP BY day ORDER BY day
